title: Where It All Began
message: This is where it all began, March 29, 2022. I still remember the nerves, my heart racing as I gathered the courage to confess to you. Lost in the 'what ifs'—what if I stay silent, what if I speak my mind? Thank God I took that leap, leaving my fears behind. This was our year zero, the dawn of our first year. A season of butterflies, overflowing affection, and drawing near. Two high school kids, falling in love and discovering something sincere.

headerTitle: Chapter I: The Test of Time
title: Reality & Resilience
message: Year one, stepping into 2023. Swept up in our own high school worlds, learning the art of understanding when time wasn't free. Thank God we weathered this storm; it taught us to guard our bond, preventing misunderstandings even when words weren't the norm. The silver lining? Every rare meeting felt beautifully profound. Truthfully, this was our hardest ground. The explosive love from before met a reality that wasn't just a dream, and inner conflicts began to gleam... Yet, we held on, swimming upstream.

title: Choosing Each Other
message: Year two, 2024. The inner battles from before reached their peak. Like the climax of a movie, we both stood stubborn, our defenses unique. But thank God, we conquered the tide once more. We chose to learn, to mature, opening a deeper door. Navigating the shift from high school halls to college days, we grew intertwined in so many ways. Our focus shifted—no longer dwelling on flaws we used to see, but on how to empower each other, maturing together, you and me.

title: Building Our Dreams
message: Year three, 2025. We have changed so much by this stage. The raging fires of past conflicts have softened into a warming glow on our page. We no longer sweat the small things, though hurdles will always appear; instead, our shared visions and dreams become crystal clear. What a profound joy to grow older, perfectly complementing each other's stride. Facing the bustling world of adults side by side means our hopes are no longer far away. We are truly building our shared dreams, day by day.

title: A Lifetime to Go
message: Four years have passed. In this fourth year, no need for flashbacks, for the chapters behind us are crystal clear. Now, there are only prayers and hopes for the road ahead: to grow wiser, to love deeper, to be the strength when the other's spirit has bled. Let’s keep being that 'couple goals' people see, not for the applause, but to build a lifelong destiny. High school is a memory, college is our present endeavor. My only hope is to walk with you through careers, family, and growing older, until we share eternal life with the Father in Heaven, forever.
